identification: Rough-sawn live-edge Tasmanian timber slab, catalogued Huon pine; roughly 2 m long, 35 to 45 cm wide by eye, thickness unknown. Pale yellow-tan with fiddleback ripple figure and small knot clusters; photo cannot confirm species (could be Huon pine or a similar pale timber such as celery top or sassafras). Gowans has sold dozens of near identical 'SLAB OF HUON PINE' lots in recent weeks.

viewing_check: Smell and cut a clean sliver or look at end grain for Huon pine's sweet oily aroma and very fine even rings; measure length, width and thickness; check for rot, splits, worm and dryness (air dried or green); photograph the figure on both faces and any birdseye.
